Legal

GDPR and Data Processing

What we do for customers who need a data processing agreement, and what you can tell your own DPO.

Template notice This page is a working template written for the PressCosmos launch build. It is drafted to be accurate and readable, but it is not legal advice. Have your counsel review it against the jurisdictions you operate in before you rely on it commercially. Last reviewed: 2026-10-30.

1. Who is the controller

For account and billing data, PressCosmos Media Network is the controller. For release content and any personal data you include in it, you are the controller and PressCosmos acts as your processor. That distinction is what the Data Processing Agreement (DPA) formalises.

2. The Data Processing Agreement

A DPA is available on request and is incorporated into enterprise and agency agreements automatically. It covers subject matter, duration, nature and purpose of processing, categories of data and data subjects, our obligations, and audit rights. Email support@presscosmos.com for a countersigned copy.

3. Subprocessors

The current list, with purpose and location, is maintained on request and updated 30 days before any change is effective, giving you a right to object.

  • Cloud hosting and CDN — United States and European Union
  • Payment processing — United States
  • Transactional email delivery — United States and European Union
  • Analytics — first-party, European Union
  • Answer-engine measurement — queries public AI systems only

4. Data residency

EU customers can select EU-only storage for account data and release drafts. Published releases are, by nature, globally distributed — that is the purpose of the service, and it is the customer's decision to publish.

5. DPIAs and consultations

We support your Data Protection Impact Assessment with technical and organisational measures documentation, a description of the processing, and reasonable assistance with supervisory authority consultations at our standard professional rates.

6. Data subject requests

If you receive a request relating to data you hold in PressCosmos, forward it and we will respond within five business days with the information needed to fulfil it. Our own subject request process is described in the privacy policy.

7. Breach notification

We notify affected controllers without undue delay and within 72 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach, with the information required by Article 33(3).

Questions about this policy? Write to support@presscosmos.com or post to PressCosmos Media Network, 2261 Market Street, Suite 4800, San Francisco, CA 94114, US.
